title: American Bitcoin (ABTC) Posts $126 Million Profit as Holdings Gain $197 Million
summary: Bitcoin Magazine American Bitcoin (ABTC) Posts $126 Million Profit as Holdings Gain $197 Million American Bitcoin swung to about $126 million in third-quarter net income after a $197.3 million gain on its bitcoin holdings, reversing a $57.2 million loss in the prior quarter. This post American Bitcoin (ABTC) Posts $126 Million Profit as Holdings Gain $197 Million first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Judge Lets Stock Perpetual Futures Keep Trading but Says CFTC Likely Overstepped Its Authority
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Judge Lets Stock Perpetual Futures Keep Trading but Says CFTC Likely Overstepped Its Authority A federal judge refused to halt stock perpetual futures on Kalshi, Coinbase Derivatives and Bitnomial but found a Cboe- and Citadel Securities-backed group likely to prove the CFTC exceeded its authority. This post Judge Lets Stock Perpetual Futures Keep Trading but Says CFTC Likely Overstepped Its Authority first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: French Bank Credit Mutuel Arkea Confirms Cyberattack as ZachXBT Puts Losses Above $133 Million
summary: Bitcoin Magazine French Bank Credit Mutuel Arkea Confirms Cyberattack as ZachXBT Puts Losses Above $133 Million Credit Mutuel Arkea says a cyberattack through a service provider enabled fraudulent transfers from its own account, while ZachXBT puts the theft above $133 million, a figure the bank has not confirmed. title: House Democrats Eye Their Own Crypto Market Structure Bill With a Bigger SEC Role After Sweep
summary: Bitcoin Magazine House Democrats Eye Their Own Crypto Market Structure Bill With a Bigger SEC Role After Sweep House Democrats are discussing a crypto market structure bill built on Rep. Maxine Waters' rejected Clarity Act amendments, with a bigger SEC role, a smaller CFTC role and new ethics limits on President Trump. This post House Democrats Eye Their Own Crypto Market Structure Bill With a Bigger SEC Role After Sweep first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Price Holds Near $80,000 as Democratic Sweep Sparks Short Squeeze
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Holds Near $80,000 as Democratic Sweep Sparks Short Squeeze Bitcoin price holds near $80,000 after rebounding from an election-night low of $75,600, as a short squeeze, a stock rally and a 9% drop in oil follow the Democratic sweep of Congress. This post Bitcoin Price Holds Near $80,000 as Democratic Sweep Sparks Short Squeeze first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Matt Corallo Flags Critical Linux Kernel Flaw; Lightning Labs Ships LND Mitigation
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Matt Corallo Flags Critical Linux Kernel Flaw; Lightning Labs Ships LND Mitigation Bitcoin Core and Lightning developer Matt Corallo highlighted CVE-2026-98432 on October 30, a use-after-free in the Linux kernel IPv4 TCP handshake code scored CVSS 9.8. Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team demonstrated a remote root exploit against systems with a Multipath TCP listener. This post Matt Corallo Flags Critical Linux Kernel Flaw; Lightning Labs Ships LND Mitigation first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .

title: Strategy’s STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy’s STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks Strategy’s STRC preferred hit $100 par on Wednesday for the first time since May, after billions in buybacks, a 12% dividend rate and a switch to daily payouts. This post Strategy’s STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Jack Dorsey’s Block (XYZ) Sets Aside $764 Million for DOJ Settlement as Bitcoin Profit Halves
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Jack Dorsey’s Block (XYZ) Sets Aside $764 Million for DOJ Settlement as Bitcoin Profit Halves Block agreed in principle to a $764 million deferred-prosecution deal over anti-money-laundering failures at Cash App, a sum that exceeds its $566 million Q3 profit, while bitcoin gross profit fell 50% after the company cut trading fees. title: Librería de Satoshi Rebrands to ISMOS, Launches Global Platform to Train One Million Bitcoin Developers
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Librería de Satoshi Rebrands to ISMOS, Launches Global Platform to Train One Million Bitcoin Developers Dulce Villarreal’s ISMOS rebrands from Latin America’s Librería de Satoshi and launches a multilingual open-source platform to train one million Bitcoin and Freedom Tech developers worldwide, backed by Btrust and the Human Rights Foundation.
